assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis is paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0.
There is a need to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended period.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes and guide further management.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The service was rendered 48 days ago.
The required precertification was missing at the time.
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197.
